assumptions: Every cron fires on schedule for the full configured month; missed, overlapping, and retried runs are not modeled.
Each crawl tick claims its full configured batch. Empty queues therefore make the estimate conservative for function calls.
Brawl fetches a player profile and battle log per target (2 upstream requests); Clash fetches one battle log per target (1 upstream request).
Child calls are approximate Convex ctx.runQuery/ctx.runMutation calls per run and per work item; database work inside those calls is not counted as another child call.
Rough database reads and writes are proxy row-operation units, not Convex invoice units or live dashboard readings.
The estimate excludes frontend traffic, manual lookups, retries, storage, bandwidth, and data-dependent prune work.

jobs.name: crawl due player logs
jobs.notes: Profile fetch, battle-log fetch, fetch telemetry, profile/ingest/target mutations.

jobs.name: discover ranked players and clubs
jobs.notes: Batch is BRAWL_CLUB_SEED; fixed requests are player and club rankings.

jobs.name: crawl battle logs
jobs.notes: One battle-log fetch and telemetry/ingest calls; optional sighting writes are not itemized.

jobs.name: discover leaderboard and clan targets
jobs.notes: Batch is CLASH_CLAN_SEED; fixed requests are board discovery and the active player board.

jobs.name: roll up deck rankings
jobs.notes: Read proxy uses the dated partial-rollup observation; write proxy assumes two windows × five modes × 100 rows.

jobs.name: observe tracked clans
jobs.notes: Poll limit is three tracked clans; each observation requests clan, current river race, and race log.
